hypothesis: The existing physical_mouse_capture_released event is emitted before async UI dispatch, so it cannot distinguish JNI release actually invoked from new-epoch cancellation, missing/moved focus, target not captured, or AndroidJavaException. Add one bounded classified outcome event for every queued ReleaseCapture attempt, without altering capture state or the JNI call conditions.
nonoverlap: T4 scheduled 1042Z is source read-only and explicitly avoids duplicate ownership repair; T5 owns APK/OBB and UI, T1/T2 water and T3 graphics. No actions running at initial head check. No changes to capture selection, world save, audio, Settings, touch, original code, scenes or assets.
safety: Classified static status strings only; no view identity/hash, user/device paths, JNI exception text, or pointer coordinates. Logger failures must not affect game. No claim that release_invoked proves OS release completion. Bounded one outcome per ReleaseCapture callback; no per-frame logs.
